title: User title/summary edit via PATCH /work-events/{id} on active CANDIDATE creates new CANDIDATE version and domain ReviewAction EDIT without merging or altering sibling Events

notion_clauses: Event Guide §6·7 — New Candidate Version on Edit (https://app.notion.com/p/3e3f86591b5f819bb94be30e4aa4b03f)
spec_delta_trace.existing_gap: Audit of EV-001..EV-018 confirmed 0 cases test title/summary edit (MVP API §5 PATCH /work-events/{id}), new CANDIDATE version creation per Event Guide §6, DB Model domain ReviewAction EDIT, or separation of edit from Event manual_merge.
spec_delta_trace.synthetic_input_summary: Derived from the same synthetic source acme-syn-lab/workflow-audit as CAND-EV-022 (grouped in bundle_cand_workflow_audit). Contains active CANDIDATE PR Event ev_init_023_1 (v1) and a separate sibling CANDIDATE PR Event ev_init_023_sibling (v1) in the same repository. User submits edit via PATCH /work-events/{id} updating title and summary on ev_init_023_1 with expected_version=1.
spec_delta_trace.expected_behavior_summary: ev_init_023_1 advances from CANDIDATE v1 to a new CANDIDATE version 2 (prior_version_preserved=true, updated curated title/summary, anchor_mode='PR', merge_origin='NONE', member_event_ids=[], original PR/commit provenance & membership unchanged) and records 1 domain ReviewAction EDIT (rev_exp_023_1, from_version=1, to_version=2, changed_fields=['title','summary'], is_event_merge=false, external_response_action_token='UNCONFIRMED'). Sibling Event ev_init_023_sibling stays untouched (v1, CANDIDATE, standalone); total_user_composite_events=0. Behavior when editing an already-CONFIRMED Event is intentionally NOT asserted in this candidate.

schema_gaps_required.limitation: case.schema.json lacks 'edit' in command_action and only allows 'UNCONFIRMED' in spec_command_name; initial_events[*]/events[*] lack curated title/summary and previous_version/prior_version_preserved; expected_proposal lacks review_actions separating DB Model domain ReviewAction (EDIT) from unconfirmed external response tokens.
schema_gaps_required.candidate_representation: Added command_action 'edit' with confirmed MVP API §5 route spec_command_name='PATCH /work-events/{id}', curated title/summary + version-lineage fields, and expected_proposal.review_actions with domain_review_action='EDIT' and external_response_action_token='UNCONFIRMED'.

This candidate follows Event Guide §6 for editing an active CANDIDATE into a new CANDIDATE version (v1->v2). Whether editing an already-CONFIRMED Event keeps CONFIRMED or demotes to CANDIDATE is intentionally excluded from this candidate's expected answer.

rationale.summary: Fills the confirmed title/summary edit gap not tested in EV-001..EV-018 using MVP API §5 PATCH /work-events/{id} and Event Guide §6's new Candidate version rule: editing title and summary on active CANDIDATE Event ev_init_023_1 (v1) creates new CANDIDATE version 2 while preserving prior version, original PR/Commit provenance, and standalone membership; records DB Model domain ReviewAction EDIT (distinct from unconfirmed external response tokens); leaves sibling Event ev_init_023_sibling untouched at v1; and creates 0 USER_COMPOSITE merges. Editing an already-CONFIRMED Event is intentionally excluded from this candidate.
